title: Rising air expands and cools
description: A single schematic parcel of moist air rises into lower surrounding pressure, expands and cools. Cooling alone does not guarantee a cloud.

style.reference: The living watershed · illustrated scientific atlas
style.artDirection: Semi-realistic layered vector landscape. Atmospheric mountain facets, sculpted foliage, restrained water highlights and precise scientific magnifications. Colour denotes substance; invisible vapour appears only as explicitly schematic molecules.

stages.title: Warm, moist air near the surface
stages.description: A translucent amber boundary identifies a parcel of air, not a giant water droplet. Its water vapour is invisible.

stages.title: Lower pressure, more room
stages.description: The same parcel rises. Lower surrounding pressure lets it expand. The expansion is linked to cooling.

stages.title: Expanded air is cooler
stages.description: The expanded parcel is now cooler and higher. No cloud is automatically created: condensation needs suitable conditions.
